description:
We are looking for an experienced Azure Data Engineer / ETL Developer for a remote position within Europe, with strong hands-on expertise in Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL and ETL development.

You will design, develop, automate and maintain scalable data integration solutions, building reliable data pipelines that extract, transform and load data into an enterprise data warehouse. The role focuses on Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, data warehousing and modern data engineering practices, working closely with technical and business stakeholders.

EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates must be based in Europe and available to travel at the start of the project and when required. Applicants must have the right to work in Europe, as a work permit is not provided.

Remote Europe | Occasional travel | 8+ years IT experience | 4+ years Data Engineering | Fluent English

Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform and load data from multiple sources into enterprise data warehouse solutions.
  • Build and optimise data processing workflows using Azure Databricks, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake and Databricks Workflows.
  • Develop and maintain data pipelines using Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (formerly Delta Live Tables) and manage data assets through Unity Catalog.
  • Design and optimise SQL queries, data transformations and dimensional data models, ensuring efficient data storage and processing.
  • Integrate data from APIs, files and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, working with Delta, Parquet and JSON formats.
  • Implement automated testing, quality assurance, debugging and production troubleshooting to maintain reliable and accurate data pipelines.
  • Apply Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices to manage development, testing, deployment and promotion of data solutions across environments.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, reporting teams and software developers to translate business requirements into technical solutions, maintain documentation and support Agile delivery.

Requirements

Profile

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree.
  • 8+ years of professional IT experience, including at least 4 years as a Data Engineer or ETL Developer.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, including PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows and Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including T-SQL and Spark SQL, with experience in Microsoft SQL Server, dimensional modelling and data warehousing.
  • Solid programming and scripting experience with Python for data transformation, automation and pipeline development.
  • Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Delta, Parquet and JSON data formats, and ingestion from APIs and files.
  • Practical knowledge of Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD, including automated testing and deployment of data solutions.
  • Strong understanding of data integration, ETL development, data quality and production troubleshooting.
  • Ability to interpret complex business requirements, communicate technical solutions and produce clear technical documentation.
  • Self-organised and comfortable working in an Agile environment, with strong collaboration skills and fluent English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Apache Airflow or Azure Functions for data orchestration and event-driven processing.
  • Knowledge of dbt, PowerShell, .NET or Java, or experience integrating data from SharePoint and Microsoft Graph.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, data governance, observability, Infrastructure as Code and data lineage.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants, such as GitHub Copilot, to support development productivity.

Key Technologies & Skills

Azure Databricks, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Databricks Workflows, Python, SQL, T-SQL, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, ETL, Data Warehousing, Azure DevOps, CI/CD
